newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin price ends unchanged at 14.59 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin price ends unchanged at 14.59 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at 14.59 ringgit ($5.88) a kg, on a lack of buying interest despite influence from a strong London market, traders said.
"There was not much demand and buyers and sellers matched positions," said a trader. "The strong LME helped keep the price steady." The LME (London Metal Exchange) rose $65 on Friday.

Final turnover was 86 tonnes against 115 on Friday. Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia. The local price was at a discount of $15 a tonne against London, compared to a premium of $90 on Friday. -- K.Baranee Krishnan (603-2307509) ($1=2.4830)
